integrity: Original mathematical argument with cited contextual literature, independently unvalidated. Classical projective-conic literature remains a possible novelty risk.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed fields, cyclic fourth-order contacts at pairwise distinct points of one line with concurrent tangent lines outside that line; excludes arbitrary arrangements and off-contact intersection census. Characteristic-two nonadjacent contacts can leave the marked line. The general theorem is proved algebraically; finite checks are corroboration, not independent validation.
title: Parity and moduli of cyclic maximal-contact conic arrangements
